definitions: To upset or offend someone by referring to a sensitive subject.
To provoke a strong emotional reaction from someone by mentioning a painful or embarrassing topic.
examples: His comment about her past failures really touched her on the raw.
I didn't mean to touch him on the raw, but I brought up his recent job loss.
Be careful what you say; that subject tends to touch him on the raw.
source: he touched me on the raw
